first.q: Which products bring customers who come back?
first.text:
Customers who start with the belt and marker bundle are worth $228 in their first 12 months, and 18% order again. Tee pack buyers rarely come back: $45 and 3%.

The bundle is also the cheapest first order to win on Meta, so it is the one to lead new customer ads with.

answers.q: Why is the cost per new customer where it is?
answers.text:
A new customer cost $52 this month against a $40 goal. Meta spend rose 13% while new customers stayed flat after the early sale ended on Nov 15.

Before Nov 15 a new customer cost $44; since then it has been $63.

answers.text: Three ads brought 61% of new customers this week. The founder story video leads with 24 at $31 each; the two static bundle ads follow at $38 and $47.
